evidence.reason: qemu_command interpolates the resolved run path directly into comma-delimited -drive option strings. A state directory containing a comma, e.g. probe,local, produces file=/.../probe,local/overlay.qcow2 and QEMU parses the comma as an option boundary rather than part of the filename. The function validates port/RAM/vCPU but does not reject comma-containing paths, and QEMU requires embedded commas in option values to be doubled.
